svg.title: Lieutenant Governor-style crowned BC shield and maple-leaf wreath — blue flag
svg.desc: The source is the same partly occluded group photograph reproduced on two slides. The flag emblem is a crowned BC shield with a maple-leaf wreath, without deer/ram supporters. Original supplied Plateforge LG vector nodes are retained. Fine embroidery, photographic occlusion and the precise flag fabric colors are not copied. The flat blue field is contextual; this is not another cloth patch.
